title: Expression-tree owner release

scope.rationale: The existing complete non-null expression destructor is canonically source-identified across compiler cleanup paths.

dependencies.caller_closure: All typed expression owners route non-null trees through this destructor.

contracts.ownership: Consumes right/list/select/window children, then left and owner unless static flags retain them.
contracts.state_and_results: Unary non-static left chains are iteratively consumed to avoid recursion.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns compiler/schema synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and cannot fail.

representation_differences: Typed flag/accessor methods replace ExprUse macros; loop preserves source tail-recursion elimination.

oracle.protocol: Destroy leaf, binary, list, SELECT, window, static, SELECT_COLUMN, and long unary-chain expressions.
oracle.normalization: Compare allocator cleanup and retained static nodes.

assurance.oom: Destructor allocates nothing and tolerates source OOM window invariant.
assurance.malformed_input: Source union and flag invariants asserted.
assurance.continuation: Consumed non-static tree cannot be reused.
assurance.performance: Linear in node count with bounded stack for unary chains.

integration.native_call_path: all compiler AST cleanup -> deleteExpression -> deleteExpressionRequired
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Existing complete implementation promoted to canonical source identity.

known_blockers: Focused topology allocator trace and independent review.

upstream_tests: Project parser, expression, and broad runtime tests
